parameters.name: IOCType
parameters.label: IOC Type
parameters.query:
CywareCTIXIndicators
| distinct IocType
| sort by IocType asc

parameters.name: Source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.query:
CywareCTIXIndicators
| mv-expand Source = Sources to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Source)
| distinct Source
| sort by Source asc

parameters.name: RiskScore
parameters.label: Risk Score
parameters.description: Filter by the CTIX confidence (risk) score: Low 0-29, Medium 30-69, High 70-100.

content.query:
CywareCTIXIndicators
| where "*" in ({IOCType}) or IocType in ({IOCType})
| where "*" in ({RiskScore}) or case(Confidence >= 70, "High", Confidence >= 30, "Medium", Confidence >= 0, "Low", "") in ({RiskScore})
| where "*" in ({Source}) or array_length(set_intersect(Sources, dynamic([{Source}]))) > 0
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count()
content.title: Total Indicators
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected filters.

content.json:
## How the Correlation Overview works
- Cyware CTIX indicators are matched **live** when the dashboard loads; nothing is stored.
- Choose a **Search Matching Algorithm**:
  - **ASIM Parsers**: CTIX indicators seen in your log data, normalised by the Microsoft Sentinel ASIM parsers. Use the **ASIM Parsers** filter to limit the log sources searched.
  - **ThreatIntelIndicators**: CTIX indicators also reported by the other threat intelligence feeds in this workspace.
- The **Time Range** applies to both the CTIX indicators and the matched log events or feed records.
- Only **active** indicators (CTIX and other feeds) are considered. The **Allowed**, **Deprecated**, **False Positive** and **Revoked** tiles also count inactive CTIX indicators that have not expired.

**Note**: Results may take a few minutes to load when a long Time Range is selected.

parameters.label: Search Matching Algorithm
parameters.description: ASIM Parsers: CTIX indicators seen in your log data. ThreatIntelIndicators: CTIX indicators also reported by the other threat intelligence feeds in this workspace.

parameters.description: Log sources (ASIM schemas) to search for CTIX indicators.

CywareCTIXCorrelate(starttime={TimeRange:start}, endtime={TimeRange:end}, asimParsers=dynamic([{ASIMParsers}]), iocTypes=dynamic([{IOCType}]), searchAlgo='{SearchMatchingAlgorithm}')
| where "*" in ({RiskScore}) or case(Confidence >= 70, "High", Confidence >= 30, "Medium", Confidence >= 0, "Low", "") in ({RiskScore})
| where "*" in ({Source}) or array_length(set_intersect(Sources, dynamic([{Source}]))) > 0
| mv-expand Name = Relations["attack-pattern"] to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Name)
| summarize ['Indicator Count'] = count(), Indicators = make_set(Indicator, 100) by ['Attack Pattern'] = Name
| sort by ['Indicator Count'] desc
| take 10000
| project ['Attack Pattern'], ['Indicator Count'], Indicators
content.title: Matched Indicators by Attack Patterns
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected filters.

| where "*" in ({RiskScore}) or case(Confidence >= 70, "High", Confidence >= 30, "Medium", Confidence >= 0, "Low", "") in ({RiskScore})
| where "*" in ({Source}) or array_length(set_intersect(Sources, dynamic([{Source}]))) > 0
| mv-expand Name = Relations["campaign"] to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Name)
| summarize ['Indicator Count'] = count() by Campaign = Name
| sort by ['Indicator Count'] desc
| extend Campaign = iff(row_number() > 10, "Others", Campaign)
| summarize ['Indicator Count'] = sum(['Indicator Count']) by Campaign
| sort by ['Indicator Count'] desc
